name: Keynote Inviter
job_description: Introduce the speaker. Keep the time during presentation and Q&A. Optionally serve as another [[Q&A Producer]].

name: Q&A Producer
job_description: Best somewhat familiar with the topic of the talk. Sit on stage, not introduced. Clarify and relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Q&A Tracker
job_description: Sit on stage, not introduced. Relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Mic Runner
job_description: Distribute a mic to questions in the audience.

name: Webinar Sentinel
job_description: Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the talk --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use headphones. If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.

name: Zoom Host
job_description: Critical role. Configure Zoom Meetings / Webinars under time constraints.
